performance.verdict: Ads never launched; 5 overdue milestones now block every revenue path.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — now 26 days overdue with no completed event recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — 25 days overdue; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms neither went live.
GBP drove 83 actions (16 calls, 25 directions, 42 web clicks) in 28 days and rose +5.56% WoW — organic is the only active demand channel right now.
GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 days (Aug 23–25) vs. a prior-3-day average of ~2.7 — a short but notable stall worth monitoring.
GHL shows 373 contacts but only 1 opportunity created and 0 appointments — intake pipeline is not converting organic inquiries at any measurable rate.

suggestions.text: Unblock all 5 overdue SOW milestones; LSA verification is the critical-path item gating every paid dollar.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue by 25–26 days, and $0 has been spent across all paid channels as a direct result. The immediate action is to confirm LSA verification was submitted (or submit today), confirm site and landing pages are live, and pass the pre-launch stack test with Nacer. Success is confirmed when LSA verification is in review, the site is accessible, and pixels are firing — target resolution by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 373 contacts, 1 opportunity, 0 appointments signals a routing or pipeline-stage failure — not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL holds 373 contacts but only 1 opportunity has been created and zero appointments booked, meaning organic leads from GBP's 16 calls and 42 web clicks are likely entering GHL and stalling. Review pipeline stage mapping, routing rules, and auto-assignment to confirm leads are being actioned within 5 minutes per SOW. Success is confirmed when new contacts are moving to an opportunity stage within 24 hours of entry — check again by 2026-08-30.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions through 2026-08-29; 3-day zero streak (Aug 23–25) may be a weekend dip or early signal of listing issue.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for three consecutive days (Aug 23–25) after averaging roughly 2.7 per day in the prior window. This may be normal weekend variability, but if actions remain at or near zero through Aug 28, investigate the GBP listing for suspension signals, missing hours, or a category change. Re-check on 2026-08-29 and escalate to a fix action if the zero streak extends beyond 5 days.
